prompt:
You receive 2 images. Image 1 is a finished background painting of our point-and-click adventure game: Dúbravská zastávka in 1995. Image 2 is the same painting with coloured boxes that only mark where the interactive objects of the new version must be. Edit image 1 into the SAME PLACE in 2020, seen by the SAME CAMERA: keep the exact viewpoint, lens, horizon, perspective and framing, and keep the position, size and outline of every building, wall, kerb, step, door, window, pole, rail and tree trunk that exists in both eras. Change only what the time changes, as described below. Keep the painting technique, brushwork, palette handling and level of detail of image 1.

The fixed landmark 'curb' stays exactly at x 262, y 792 (14 % from the left, 73 % from the top). The fixed landmark 'track_line' stays exactly at x 1524, y 813 (79 % from the left, 75 % from the top). The fixed landmark 'clock_frame' stays exactly at x 785, y 134 (41 % from the left, 12 % from the top).

Era changes: the same stop on Thursday 29 October 2020, a sunny autumn afternoon: warm low sunlight, long soft shadows, the lindens and trees in yellow, orange and brown autumn colours, some fallen leaves on the platform and on the grass. The tram line was rebuilt in 2019-2020, so:
- The old brown tube shelter with its blue roof and wooden back wall is gone. In exactly its place and footprint stands a modern shelter: a slim dark grey steel frame, a flat clear glass roof, clear glass back and side walls with thin vertical white stripes, a modern grey metal bench inside along the back. Through its glass the road, the lawn and the trees stay visible. A small paper notice with a face-mask pictogram (no text) is stuck on the glass.
- The platform has new paving of light beige concrete tiles, a terracotta-red strip along its middle and a light tactile edge strip along the track; the low road-side wall is new light concrete with galvanised steel railings, but its old chipped end at the ramp is unchanged.
- The stop post is a modern dark grey post in the same place: on top the SAME round clock with its old polished brass frame (now around a new white dial), below the clock an LED departure board with orange dot-matrix dots that form no readable words or digits, and lower down a modern timetable panel with illegible print.
- The track is rebuilt: new rails on new concrete sleepers and fresh grey ballast, a low dark green mesh fence on short posts between the two tracks, new slim grey traction poles and overhead wires in the same places. NO tram: the near track in front of the platform is empty, so paint the track, the grass strip, the far road and the trees that were hidden behind the old tram.
- Two or three modern parked cars on the far road at the right (no number plates). No people.
Everything else built (the platform's position and edges, the ramp and zebra crossing, the road, the panel towers, the shopping pavilion) stays exactly where it is.

Interactive props of 2020:
1. the box labelled 'Rám starých hodín' in image 2 (x 722-850, y 68-200 of the 1920x1080 frame (38-44 % from the left, 6-19 % from the top)): the round clock on top of the stop post: the old, slightly worn polished brass frame around a crisp new white dial with black ticks.
2. the box labelled 'Starý obrubník' in image 2 (x 212-352, y 738-850 of the 1920x1080 frame (11-18 % from the left, 68-79 % from the top)): the old chipped corner of the concrete kerb where the low road-side wall ends at the ramp - the same chip as before, a little more weathered.
3. the box labelled 'Elektronická tabuľa' in image 2 (x 700-875, y 288-380 of the 1920x1080 frame (36-46 % from the left, 27-35 % from the top)): the black LED departure board on the stop post below the clock, glowing orange dot-matrix dots (no readable words or digits).
the box labelled 'exit: Pred ZŠ Sokolíkova v roku 2020' in image 2 (x 40-255, y 780-930 of the 1920x1080 frame (2-13 % from the left, 72-86 % from the top)) is the ramp and zebra crossing at the near left (towards the school). the box labelled 'exit: Ulica medzi plotmi' in image 2 (x 930-1180, y 520-660 of the 1920x1080 frame (48-61 % from the left, 48-61 % from the top)) is the far end of the platform.

Walkable floor: the band at x 0-1449, y 670-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-75 % from the left, 62-94 % from the top) stays the open, flat platform with nothing standing on it, only light, shadows and a few fallen leaves.
This room has no NPC zones.

Fiction rules: no stop name, no transport-company logos, no line numbers, no brands, no shop signs, no number plates, no people, no animals. Any paper shows only illegible scribbles, no digits.

Image 2 is a positioning aid only: do NOT draw any of its boxes, outlines, labels or captions. The result is image 1 edited, in the same 16:9 framing: no frames, no borders, no UI, no captions, no watermark, no text except what is asked for above, and no people or animals unless stated above.

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
